paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the growth in the total number of AI Scientist papers on arXiv over time, categorized by whether they include implementation details. The x-axis represents time, labeled with three discrete seasonal intervals: “Fall ’24”, “Winter ’24”, and “Spring ’25”, indicating a chronological progression across academic terms. The y-axis, labeled “Quantity”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 24, with major tick marks at intervals of 3, representing the count of papers. Two lines are plotted: the “Without Implementation” line, shown in teal with circular markers and a solid line, begins at 10 papers in Fall ’24, rises to 15 in Winter ’24, and reaches 21 in Spring ’25. The “With Implementation” line, shown in orange with square markers and a solid line, starts at 2 papers in Fall ’24, increases to 7 in Winter ’24, and climbs to 13 in Spring ’25. Both lines show steady upward trends, with the “Without Implementation” category consistently higher in quantity across all time points. The area beneath each line is shaded in a translucent version of its respective color, visually emphasizing the cumulative growth of each category.
